title: LightY-01/llm-inference-engine
summary: LightY-01/llm-inference-engine 是一个基于 PyTorch 的高性能 LLM 推理引擎，通过实现 KV 缓存、连续批处理和推测解码来优化服务吞吐量，适用于需要高效推理的场景。
description: A high-performance LLM inference engine built from scratch in PyTorch, implementing KV-caching, continuous batching, and speculative decoding to optimize serving throughput.
